entry.title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
entry.summary: CrowdStrike said it will buy Fiddler AI, which makes AI agent observability software, and Dreadnode, which helps companies automate AI security testing.

entry.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
entry.summary: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

entry.title: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027

entry.title: Ten years later, ‘Pokémon Go to the polls’ still haunts the internet

entry.title: Reddit tests ads in search results as traffic declines and growth concerns mount
entry.summary: The new ad placements could help Reddit squeeze more revenue from existing users as Google's AI search changes how people discover its content.

entry.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges

entry.title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist
entry.summary: Cybersecurity experts have long warned of the persistent and patient threat from North Korea's long-running hacks. The world's largest crypto exchange was still caught off-guard.

entry.summary: An in-space construction first could be an enabler for the space data centers of the future.

entry.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
entry.summary: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

entry.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
entry.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

entry.title: India’s EloElo nabs $80M from NBCUniversal to bet on the country’s rising microdrama market
entry.summary: More than 118 million users watch microdramas every month as the serialized format has taken off in India. EloElo's Story TV is one of the top apps for microdramas, with over 33 million active users, according to analysts.
